rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for doing or presenting something in an attractive, inviting way.

example.english: They arranged the room invitingly, making their friends want to come in and sit down.
example.traditional: 佢將間房布置得好吸引，搞到啲朋友一見到就想入嚟坐。
